note: Twig UI Templates stores each managed template as a `twig_template` config entity (config_prefix=template -> config name twig_ui.template.<id>) with keys status, id, label, theme_suggestion, template_code, themes[]. Enabling a template makes the twig_ui.template_manager service write public://twig_ui/<theme>/<suggestion-with-dashes>.html.twig and hook_theme() registers it as an override; only one enabled template is allowed per theme_suggestion+theme (TemplateManager::templateExists / form validation). Global settings live in the twig_ui.settings config object (allowed_themes all|selected, allowed_theme_list, default_selected_themes, codemirror_config). Admin UIs: /admin/structure/templates and /admin/config/system/twig_ui. Medium/hard cases are grounded in those real config entities and the settings object; the site's enabled themes are olivero (default) and claro.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module twig_ui (Twig UI Templates), what kind of Drupal object is a saved Twig UI template, and what config name / entity type id is it stored under?
evals.expected_output: Each template is a config entity of type twig_template (config_prefix=template), stored as configuration named twig_ui.template.<id> with keys status, id, label, theme_suggestion, template_code and themes.

evals.prompt: With twig_ui, which property of a Twig UI template determines which template it overrides, and where on disk does the module write the actual template file when the template is enabled?
evals.expected_output: The theme_suggestion property (e.g. node__article) plus the selected themes decide what it overrides. When enabled, the twig_ui.template_manager writes public://twig_ui/<theme>/<suggestion-with-underscores-as-dashes>.html.twig and hook_theme() registers it so it overrides the file-based template.

evals.prompt: In twig_ui, can two enabled Twig UI templates override the same theme suggestion for the same theme at once? And which config object controls which themes are even selectable for new templates?
evals.expected_output: No - only one enabled template may target a given theme_suggestion + theme combination; the form validates this via TemplateManager::templateExists(). The twig_ui.settings config object (allowed_themes = all|selected, allowed_theme_list) controls which themes are selectable.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Twig UI template configured through the twig_ui module. Inspect the live configuration and give the template's machine name (id) and the theme suggestion it overrides.
evals.expected_output: The template id is twui_known; its config (twig_ui.template.twui_known) has theme_suggestion region__sidebar_first and targets the olivero theme.

evals.prompt: This site has two Twig UI templates (twig_ui module): twui_on and twui_off. Exactly one of them is enabled/active. Inspect the live configuration and state which one is enabled.
evals.expected_output: twui_on is enabled (status: true) and twui_off is disabled (status: false); check the status key on twig_ui.template.twui_on vs twig_ui.template.twui_off.

evals.prompt: Using the twig_ui module on this site, create a Twig UI template with machine name twui_task that overrides the page__front theme suggestion for the Olivero theme. It must be enabled and may contain any template code. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A twig_template config entity twui_task exists with theme_suggestion=page__front, themes containing olivero, and status=true (e.g. created via the twig_template storage or the /admin/structure/templates/add form).

evals.prompt: Configure the twig_ui module's global settings on this site so that new Twig UI templates may only be created for the Olivero theme (restrict the allowed themes to a selected list containing only olivero). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In twig_ui.settings, allowed_themes is set to 'selected' and allowed_theme_list contains 'olivero' (set via the settings form at /admin/config/system/twig_ui or drush config).
